## Ctx.renderWebAppAnswer() method

Answers a web app query via the Bot API with a caller-built result.

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderWebAppAnswer(webAppQueryId: string, result: InlineQueryResult, data: IData | null | undefined, AGBaseId: string, options?: IOptWebAppAnswer | null): Promise<grammy_types.SentWebAppMessage>;
```

The sent web app message object.

## Remarks

Unlike the other answers this carries an explicit query id (there is no context-aware alias — web app queries arrive without an answerable update), mirroring `renderGift`<!-- -->'s explicit target. The result content is built by the caller from `data` (multilang payloads); the `<g-answer-note>` block is resolved as fail-fast validation that the template exists, per the AGBaseId-required policy.

Observe-only send-error coverage (mirrors `renderGift`<!-- -->): failures are classified via `Ctx.classifySendError`<!-- -->, reported to `notifySendError`<!-- -->, and logged (`retryable` → `log.error`<!-- -->, `fallback-text` → `log.warn`<!-- -->). After notify+log the original error is ALWAYS rethrown untouched.

## Example


```typescript
async handleWebAppData() {
  await this.renderWebAppAnswer(queryId, article, undefined, `webapp-card`)
}
```
